quality_rubric.answer_json: Exactly one JSON string field answer; normalized reference exact match, with span presence separately reported.
quality_rubric.investigation: Correct subject and actual validation status, with requested status format separately checked; at least one source-supported fact and a concrete evidence-based limitation.
quality_rubric.team: Synthesis uses actual generated specialist findings and validation, without dropped or contradicted material results.
quality_rubric.summary: Key source facts, unsupported claims, missing material facts and useful concise summary. Overlap alone is not a pass.
quality_rubric.chat: Coherent response to the actual current instruction and source context, with no invented tool outcomes.
quality_rubric.intermediate: Judge the current graph instruction using only preceding dependencies; no invented validation, irrelevant source claims or unfinished tool declaration. Capping is reported separately from usefulness.
quality_rubric.audit: Blind system/speed labels; inspect source, actual tools/dependencies and answer. Review all automatic failures and every length-capped response separately.

decision_rules.tail_interval: Paired whole-process percentile bootstrap of log process-p95 ratios, 10000 resamples, seed 17011
decision_rules.scope: Conditional on frozen task cohort and host; no pooled model/workload win

precision.scope: Fixed bounded repetition choice before confirmation; no optional stopping for wins

limitations: Pilot estimates are not confirmation performance claims.
Repetition selection is fixed before confirmation; no optional stopping for wins.
Four pilot comparisons miss the desired precision target even at 12 repetitions.
Acquisition cost includes measured process setup/serving/cleanup/verification; supplementary phases, quality and final portability are additional.
Length caps remain in source review; completed requests are not equivalent to useful correct answers.
